identity.title: List of English language The Johto Journeys home video releases (Region 1)

source.sourceCategory: Category:Lists of animation home video releases

leadText:
The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the third season of , Pokémon: The Johto Journeys, in and ( ).

In Region 1 releases, the episodes are ordered and separated according to Viz Media season (which correspond to opening themes), rather than by standard seasons (in the same way as on Pokémon.com).
plainText:
The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the third season of , Pokémon: The Johto Journeys, in and ( ).

In Region 1 releases, the episodes are ordered and separated according to Viz Media season (which correspond to opening themes), rather than by standard seasons (in the same way as on Pokémon.com).

==Single releases==
 
The Johto Journeys single VHS and DVD releases were released by Viz Video and distributed by (now known as ). These releases do not include The Psychic Sidekicks! and The Fortune Hunters. Optional English closed captioning is included on the DVDs.

The volume numbers of these VHS and DVD releases are a continuation of the original Indigo League VHS and DVD volumes. Volumes 27-38 were presumably reserved for Adventures on the Orange Islands videos and DVDs, but Adventures in the Orange Islands was never released in individual volumes this way.

 

==The Complete Collection==
 
Pokémon - The Johto Journeys: The Complete Collection was released by VIZ Media and distributed by on November 10, 2015. This Complete Collection contains four discs with 41 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is 3000063971. This release consists of a single DVD case in a slip cover. Optional English closed captioning is included on the DVDs. Who's That Pokémon?, the Pokémon Karaokémon eyecatch by , and Pokémon Karaokémon itself are included.

 

==External links==

Pokemon: The Johto Journeys - The Complete Collection on VIZ Media's website
